login.title: Two-factor authentication
login.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.rejected: This sign-in is no longer valid (it has expired or was already used). Please log in again.
login.wrongCode: The code is wrong. Please check it and try again.
login.expired: This sign-in has expired. Please log in again.

settings.title: Two-factor authentication
settings.statusOff: Off. Turn it on to require a code from an authenticator app at every log in.
settings.scanTitle: Step 1: Add Taskly to your authenticator app
settings.scanHint: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app on another device, or enter the secret key below.
settings.openApp: Open the authenticator app on this device
settings.confirmTitle: Step 2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
settings.wrongCode: Wrong code, try the latest one
settings.recoveryHint: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once when you cannot open your authenticator app. They are shown only once.
settings.regenerateHint: Enter a current 6-digit code. The old recovery codes stop working.
settings.disableMessage: Your account will be protected by your password only. Enter your password and a 6-digit code to confirm.
settings.notSetup: The setup expired. Please start again.
settings.alreadyEnabled: Two-factor authentication was already turned on elsewhere.
